text: Core courses Management, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Operations Research, Management Information System, Management Statistics, Information Resource Management, Information Network Analysis and Design, Data Structure and Database and Computer Network. Objective This objective is to train students to be applied talents to do information system development, information management and consultation in enterprises and institutions of various types. This objective is to train students to be innovative talents who have the solid foundation of management; have acquaintance with the basic theory of modern management, economics and the science of information; skillfully grasp the analytical methods of information system. Meanwhile, they have relatively wide knowledge, strong scientific research ability, initiative spirit and practice capability. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management is granted.
